text_body.text: Reduce vibration artifacts like ringing and ghosting
text_body.translation_tag: Reduce vibration artifacts like ringing and ghosting

text_small.text: Input shaping reduces ringing and ghosting artifacts caused by printer vibrations during fast movements.
text_small.translation_tag: Input shaping reduces ringing and ghosting artifacts caused by printer vibrations during fast movements.

text_small.text: Connect an ADXL345 accelerometer to calibrate
text_small.translation_tag: Connect an ADXL345 accelerometer to calibrate

text_small.text: Moves the print head to measure vibration frequencies on each axis. Takes 2-3 minutes. The printer will make noise — this is normal.
text_small.translation_tag: Moves the print head to measure vibration frequencies on each axis. Takes 2-3 minutes. The printer will make noise — this is normal.

text_small.text: Do not touch the printer during calibration
text_small.translation_tag: Do not touch the printer during calibration

text_small.text: Firmware saved X = Y's value; the measured X result was discarded
